{{Quote|This will be our first stronghold, from which all our future conquests must proceed.|Dal Zorfenn|<ref name="marvel97" />}}
'''Dal Zorfenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Nagai expeditionary force]]. Alongside his subordinate, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Cyn Jodu]], Zorfenn was tasked with securing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]] that it might serve as the primary base of operations for the Nagai fleet's planned [[Nagai–Tof War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="nagai">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dal Zorfenn first appeared [[Star Wars (1977) 97|''Star Wars'' (1977) 97]], written by [[Mary Jo Duffy]], illustrated by [[Cynthia Martin]] and released in [[1985]].<ref name="marvel97" /> Initially unnamed in his sole comic appearance, the character received his name in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs]]."<ref name="nagai" /> Zorfenn was named after [[Ron Frenz]], the artist who drew the very first Nagai.<ref name="jmm">{{WebCite|url=http://www.myuselessknowledge.com/swfa/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=95|text=Endnotes for The Forgotten War -- Addendum|archivedate=20170820110424}}</ref>
